chunk_map.heading: Safe to say it's wrong (H1 + include links)
Agents get checked, people don't get watched
"The agent got this wrong" costs nobody face

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1 line 6 (slide agents-checked-people-not-watched.md): "That line leans on what Amy Edmondson calls psychological safety" - closest; "That line" resolves to the chunk's own opening sentence at line 4. chunk 2 line 6 "it has to stay cheap" resolves to "the sentence" in the same bullet.

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no cross-file or positional callbacks; slide 2 is only named in the maintainer block

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no "the X you did/saw/caught" backward references in either chunk

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/reveal demo beat; no terminal or screen-bound cue

rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 line 8: "So say it out loud, early, about anything an agent produced." - closest to a thin close, but chunk carries three self-carrying paragraphs and its own claim in the header; neither chunk is a wait-state.

chunk 2 header "The agent got this wrong" costs nobody face vs line 4 "what gets questioned is the agent's output, not a person" - header is the summary. chunk 1 header vs line 4 "Checking the agent's work is not watching the person" - same claim.

chunk 1 line 6: "not permissiveness and not relentless positivity" - closest; one sentence attributed to Edmondson, not a Not X. Not Y. Z construction. "ask more, admit more, and learn more" is a borrowed triplet with concrete verbs, not anaphora. No superlative, number, abstraction stack.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep of dialect terms (compendium, forcing function, beat, mood, writing surface, firing) over the two slide bodies: 0. Closest: chunk 1 line 8 "scrutiny" - ordinary English.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c "\*\*" over slide bodies above the maintainer cut: 0 (both slide files, lines 1-8).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: check-slide-size.js --file reports "slides: 2", so both included slide files reach the composed deck; the lecture body is two standalone include links (lines 3, 5).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers; check-slide-numbering.js OK: "1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent"

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: both lecture headings are claims: "Agents get checked, people don't get watched" and "\"The agent got this wrong\" costs nobody face"; no imperative labels in a lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 line 6: "A digest nobody dares question gets checked by nobody." - closest to an aphorism kicker, but it is mid-slide and gives the reason the sentence must stay cheap, not a restatement of the header. chunk 1 line 8 last sentence adds the training frame (production cheap, deciding not).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header rename evident; maintainer blocks record first cut / rebuild, no old-header body retained

notes: No accept-notes in the lecture maintainer block (Quality and Time/Learning lines only). Slide-file maintainer blocks carry no accept-notes either. Slide-file wording defects belong to the slide files.
